thread:
jessica_cs: Heads-up: Polaris reserved cluster scheduled for warm handoff tomorrow 09:00 PT. Final checklist: quotas, autoscale tuning, priming steps, and fallback routing. Who's got what?

oliver_se: I'll run the smoke + observability capture. Plan: 45m test with steady ~800qps then a few 30s microbursts to validate tail. Need final quota and model fallbacks.

mike_sre: I'll take autoscale tuning and infra warm validation. Want to avoid flapping on the first spikes. Can we limit rapid scale-ups for first 15m?

jessica_cs: Good call. Let's keep a conservative scale policy initially. Also we need an on-call list for rollback.

rachel_billing: Confirmed billing anchor holds. Allocated quota = 1,000,000 tokens/day. Will surface if they exceed commitment during the test.

nina_security: VPC peering confirmed. I still want a quick egress port check and to verify host routes. No KMS issues.

leo_modelops: Primary model = redwood-gpt-large-v2, fallback = redwood-gpt-large-quantized-v2, alt-route = redwood-gpt-medium-v2. Variant IDs: lg-v2-202603, lg-v2-q8_202603, md-v2-202603. I'll drop these in the config.

mike_sre: Proposed autoscale knobs for initial warm:
```
min_replicas: 4
max_replicas: 22
scale_up_rps: 1500
scale_down_rps: 900
scale_window_secs: 240
initial_stabilization_secs: 900
```
Start conservative, relax after warm window.

oliver_se: Load script: 10m kv-prime, 45m steady 800qps mix (60% chat / 40% embeddings), then 5 x 30s microbursts to 1.8k. Command: 
```
rally run --config polaris-smoke.yaml --out smoke-$(date +%s).ndjson --duration 60m
```
I'll upload artifacts to the shared run bucket.

perf-bot: Dashboard snapshot created: /dashboards/polaris-smoke/1807777001. Auto-collect: p99_latency, error_rate, token_throughput, mem_headroom.

jessica_cs: Who's the primary for customer communications during the window? Tera normally?

tera_enable: I'll be on the customer thread and run the short enablement checklist. I'll also kick off the demo after the smoke if all green.

mike_sre: Small tweak: for the very first burst we should set a 60s ramp for the spike to catch hot-paths without immediate scale pressure.

oliver_se: Noted. I'll implement microbursts with 60s ramp instead of instantaneous. Will include KV priming pass 15 minutes before the run.

jessica_cs: Rollback plan?

mike_sre: Rollback = route traffic to dedicated fallback pool (polaris-fallback-1) + reduce qps to 200, then revert reserved-pool routing rules. Script: 
```
./ops/rollback.sh --pool polaris-fallback-1 --scale-to 3
```
Oncall: mike_sre, oliver_se, tera_enable.

leo_modelops: Also recommend auto-fallback in routing: if memory OOM or tail error > 2% for 2 mins, switch to lg-v2-q8_202603. I'll open a quick config patch.

rachel_billing: Reminder: if test burns >10% over daily quota in that window, billing will alert. We'll be lenient for the smoke but will capture usage.

deploy-bot: Reserved pool config PR #512 merged. Deploy scheduled 09:00-09:10 PT. Healthchecks and canary routing enabled.

perf-bot: Preflight check results: mem_headroom OK on nodes, token_cache primed in staging. No obvious hotspots.

jessica_cs: Great. Quick ownership recap: load + artifacts = oliver_se; autoscale + rollback + infra = mike_sre; enablement comms = tera_enable; model variants = leo_modelops; billing = rachel_billing; security = nina_security.

oliver_se: After the test I'll post a short summary (1-2 bullets): SLO hit (p99), any errors, and suggested follow-ups.

mike_sre: I'll check scaling traces and CPU/GPU saturation; flag any tuning needs.

jessica_cs: Perfect. If anyone spots an unaccounted blocker drop it here. Otherwise we'll run the smoke tomorrow 09:00 PT. :rocket:
